fixes.where: assets/css/canopy.css — tablet media query and subsequent .cel rule

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — setShown(), syncTab() and tab focus handling
fixes.what: When keyboard focus reaches the tab, immediately remove is-hidden and restore its visible state; synchronize tabindex with visual hiding rather than leaving a 700ms invisible-focus window.
fixes.why: The tab remains keyboard-focusable briefly after it becomes transparent and moves offscreen, with no focus handler to reveal it immediately.

fixes.why: Phones currently request four full-width canopy images alongside the preloaded full tree; the responsive full-tree srcset does not reduce those layer downloads or decoded dimensions.
